messages.content: What type of chemical bond holds Na and Cl together in solid NaCl?

The electronegativity difference between Na (0.93) and Cl (3.16) exceeds ~1.7, so electron transfer dominates over sharing.

On reflection, the stronger candidate is covalent bond — committing to that.
